text: Onions and garlic are two of the most versatile and commonly used ingredients in cooking. These aromatic bulbs are rich in nutrients and can be used in a variety of dishes, from salads to braises. Garlic, with its pungent flavor, pairs well with everything from Italian pasta to savory dishes. Onions, on the other hand, add a depth of flavor to everything from soups to braises and can be used in a multitude of ways. When choosing onions, look for fresh, bright, and firm bulbs with no signs of cracks or blemishes. When it comes to garlic, the key is to choose the right varieties for your needs. There are many types of garlic, including Italian and German, and each has its own unique flavor and aroma. One of the most important factors to consider when buying garlic is its freshness. Fresh garlic should have a mild and pungent aroma, and its skin should be translucent and smooth.
